title: PACT: From Credit Assignment to Critic Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2609.26355v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a central component of large language model (LLM) post-training, yet token-level credit lacks a generally accepted mathematical definition, leaving its relationship to commonly used training signals unclear. We formulate three regularity conditions, namely Completeness, Prefix Consistency, and Neutrality, and prove that they uniquely determine token-level credit. This characterization provides a unified basis for explaining phenomena across existing algorithms and guides the development of an improved actor-critic training procedure. Through this lens, an ideal teacher in On-Policy Distillation (OPD) acts as an implicit critic, yielding an expected policy gradient proportional to that induced by token-level credit. translated_title: PACT：从信用分配到评论家对齐
translated_abstract: 摘要：强化学习已成为大语言模型（LLM）后训练的核心组成部分，然而词元级信用缺乏一个被普遍接受的数学定义，导致其与常用训练信号之间的关系尚不明确。我们提出了三个规范性条件，即完备性、前缀一致性和中性性，并证明它们唯一地确定了词元级信用。这一刻画为解释现有算法中的各类现象提供了统一基础，并指导了一种改进的演员-评论家训练流程的开发。在这一视角下，在线策略蒸馏中的理想教师充当隐式评论家，其产生的期望策略梯度与词元级信用所诱导的策略梯度成正比。响应级的REINFORCE留一法信号尽管粒度更粗，其期望策略梯度贡献仍与词元级信用相匹配。我们进一步建立了近似……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出完备性、前缀一致性与中性性三个规范性条件可唯一定义词元级信用分配，据此统一解释了在线策略蒸馏（OPD作为隐式评论家）和RLOO等现有算法的训练信号机制，并指导设计了一种改进的演员-评论家训练方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that three regularity conditions—Completeness, Prefix Consistency, and Neutrality—uniquely determine token-level credit, providing a unified theoretical basis that explains the ideal teacher in On-Policy Distillation as an implicit critic, shows RLOO signals match token-level credit in expectation, and guides an improved actor-critic training procedure.
